articles.title_en: Estimation and inference in games of incomplete information with unobserved heterogeneity and large state space
articles.title_cn: 具有未观测异质性和大状态空间的不完全信息博弈的估计与推断
articles.abstract_en: Building on the sequential identification result of Aguirregabiria and Mira (2019), this paper develops estimation and inference procedures for static games of incomplete information with payoff‐relevant unobserved heterogeneity and multiple equilibria. With payoff‐relevant unobserved heterogeneity, sequential estimation and inference face two main challenges: the matching‐types problem and a large number of matchings. We tackle the matching‐types problem by constructing a new minimum‐distance criterion for the correct matching and the payoff function with both correct and incorrect “moments.” To handle large numbers of matchings, we propose a novel and computationally fast multistep moment selection procedure. We show that asymptotically, it achieves a time complexity that is linear in the number of “moments” when the occurrence of multiple equilibria does not depend on the number of “moments.” Based on this procedure, we construct a consistent estimator of the payoff function, an asymptotically uniformly valid and easy‐to‐implement test for linear hypotheses on the payoff function, and a consistent method to group payoff functions according to the unobserved heterogeneity. Extensive simulations demonstrate the finite sample efficacy of our procedures.
articles.abstract_cn: 基于Aguirregabiria和Mira（2019）的序贯识别结果，本文为具有支付相关未观测异质性和多重均衡的静态不完全信息博弈开发了估计和推断程序。在存在支付相关未观测异质性的情况下，序贯估计和推断面临两个主要挑战：匹配类型问题和大量匹配问题。我们通过构建一个新的最小距离准则来解决匹配类型问题，该准则针对正确匹配和支付函数，同时包含正确和不正确的“矩”。为了处理大量匹配，我们提出了一种新颖且计算快速的多步矩选择程序。我们证明，在渐近意义上，当多重均衡的发生不依赖于“矩”的数量时，该程序的时间复杂度与“矩”的数量呈线性关系。基于该程序，我们构建了支付函数的一致估计量，一个渐近均匀有效且易于实施的关于支付函数线性假设的检验，以及一种根据未观测异质性对支付函数进行分组的一致方法。大量模拟证明了我们程序的有限样本有效性。

articles.title_en: Robust machine learning algorithms for text analysis
articles.title_cn: 用于文本分析的稳健机器学习算法
articles.abstract_en: We study the Latent Dirichlet Allocation model, a popular Bayesian algorithm for text analysis. We show that the model's parameters are not identified, which suggests that the choice of prior matters. We characterize the range of values that the posterior mean of a given functional of the model's parameters can attain in response to a change in the prior, and we suggest two algorithms that report this range. Both of our algorithms rely on obtaining multiple Nonnegative Matrix Factorizations of either the posterior draws of the corpus' population term‐document frequency matrix or of its maximum likelihood estimator. The key idea is to maximize/minimize the functional of interest over all these nonnegative matrix factorizations. To illustrate the applicability of our results, we revisit recent work studying the effects of increased transparency on the communication structure of monetary policy discussions in the United States.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了潜在狄利克雷分配模型，这是一种流行的用于文本分析的贝叶斯算法。我们表明该模型的参数不可识别，这意味着先验的选择很重要。我们刻画了在改变先验时，模型参数的给定泛函的后验均值可以取值的范围，并提出了两种报告该范围的算法。我们的两种算法都依赖于对语料库总体词项-文档频率矩阵的后验抽取或其最大似然估计进行多次非负矩阵分解。关键思想是在所有这些非负矩阵分解上最大化/最小化感兴趣的泛函。为了说明我们结果的适用性，我们重新审视了最近研究美国货币政策讨论中透明度提高对沟通结构影响的工作。

articles.title_cn: 分层实验中的协变量调整
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies covariate adjusted estimation of the average treatment effect in stratified experiments. We work in a general framework that includes matched tuples designs, coarse stratification, and complete randomization as special cases. Regression adjustment with treatment‐covariate interactions is known to weakly improve efficiency for completely randomized designs. By contrast, we show that for stratified designs such regression estimators are generically inefficient, potentially even increasing estimator variance relative to the unadjusted benchmark. Motivated by this result, we derive the asymptotically optimal linear covariate adjustment for a given stratification. We construct several feasible estimators that implement this efficient adjustment in large samples. In the special case of matched pairs, for example, the regression including treatment, covariates, and pair fixed effects is asymptotically optimal. We also provide novel asymptotically exact inference methods that allow researchers to report smaller confidence intervals, fully reflecting the efficiency gains from both stratification and adjustment. Simulations and an empirical application demonstrate the value of our proposed methods.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了分层实验中平均处理效应的协变量调整估计。我们在一个一般框架下工作，该框架包括匹配元组设计、粗略分层和完全随机化作为特例。已知带有处理-协变量交互的回归调整可以微弱地提高完全随机化设计的效率。相比之下，我们表明对于分层设计，这类回归估计量通常是低效的，甚至可能相对于未调整的基准增加估计量方差。受此结果启发，我们推导出给定分层下的渐近最优线性协变量调整。我们构造了几种在大样本中实现这种有效调整的可行估计量。例如，在匹配对的特殊情况下，包括处理、协变量和对固定效应的回归是渐近最优的。我们还提供了新颖的渐近精确推断方法，使研究人员能够报告更小的置信区间，充分反映分层和调整带来的效率增益。模拟和实证应用证明了我们提出的方法的价值。

articles.title_en: Design‐robust two‐way‐fixed‐effects regression for panel data
articles.title_cn: 面板数据的设计稳健双向固定效应回归
articles.abstract_en: We propose a new estimator for average causal effects of a binary treatment with panel data in settings with general treatment patterns. Our approach augments the popular two‐way‐fixed‐effects specification with unit‐specific weights that arise from a model for the assignment mechanism. We show how to construct these weights in various settings, including the staggered adoption setting, where units opt into the treatment sequentially but permanently. The resulting estimator converges to an average (over units and time) treatment effect under the correct specification of the assignment model, even if the fixed‐ effect model is misspecified. We show that our estimator is more robust than the conventional two‐way estimator: it remains consistent if either the assignment mechanism or the two‐way regression model is correctly specified. In addition, the proposed estimator performs better than the two‐way‐fixed‐effect estimator if the outcome model and assignment mechanism are locally misspecified. This strong robustness property underlines and quantifies the benefits of modeling the assignment process and motivates using our estimator in practice. We also discuss an extension of our estimator to handle dynamic treatment effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种新的估计量，用于在一般处理模式下，利用面板数据估计二元处理的平均因果效应。我们的方法在流行的双向固定效应规范中加入了由分配机制模型产生的单位特定权重。我们展示了如何在各种设置中构建这些权重，包括交错采纳设置，其中单位依次但永久地选择接受处理。在分配模型正确指定的情况下，即使固定效应模型被错误指定，所得估计量也会收敛到平均（跨单位和时间）处理效应。我们表明，我们的估计量比传统的双向估计量更稳健：如果分配机制或双向回归模型中的任何一个被正确指定，它仍然是一致的。此外，如果结果模型和分配机制局部错误指定，所提出的估计量比双向固定效应估计量表现更好。这种强稳健性属性强调并量化了对分配过程建模的好处，并激励在实践中使用我们的估计量。我们还讨论了我们的估计量扩展到处理动态处理效应的情况。

articles.title_en: Dynamic regression discontinuity under treatment effect heterogeneity
articles.title_cn: 处理效应异质性下的动态断点回归
articles.abstract_en: Regression discontinuity is a popular tool for analyzing economic policies or treatment interventions. This research extends the classic static RD model to a dynamic framework, where observations are eligible for repeated RD events and, therefore, treatments. Such dynamics often complicate the identification and estimation of long‐term average treatment effects. Empirical papers with such designs have so far ignored the dynamics or adopted restrictive identifying assumptions. This paper presents identification strategies under various sets of weaker identifying assumptions and proposes associated estimation and inference methods. The proposed methods are applied to revisit the seminal study of Cellini, Ferreira, and Rothstein (2010) on long‐term effects of California local school bonds.
articles.abstract_cn: 断点回归是分析经济政策或处理干预的常用工具。本研究将经典静态RD模型扩展至动态框架，其中观测值有资格参与重复的RD事件，从而接受处理。这种动态性常常使长期平均处理效应的识别和估计复杂化。迄今为止，采用此类设计的实证论文要么忽略了动态性，要么采用了限制性的识别假设。本文在各种较弱的识别假设集合下提出了识别策略，并提出了相应的估计和推断方法。所提出的方法被应用于重新审视Cellini、Ferreira和Rothstein（2010）关于加州地方学区债券长期效应的开创性研究。

articles.title_cn: 从两个次序统计量解卷积
articles.abstract_en: Economic data are often contaminated by measurement errors and truncated by ranking. This paper shows that the classical measurement error model with independent and additive measurement errors is identified nonparametrically using only two order statistics of repeated measurements. The identification result confirms a hypothesis by Athey and Haile (2002) for a symmetric ascending auction model with unobserved heterogeneity. Extensions allow for heterogeneous measurement errors, broadening the applicability to additional empirical settings, including asymmetric auctions and wage offer models. We adapt an existing simulated sieve estimator and illustrate its performance in finite samples.
articles.abstract_cn: 经济数据常常受到测量误差的污染，并因排序而被截断。本文表明，经典测量误差模型在独立且可加测量误差的假设下，仅利用重复测量的两个次序统计量即可非参数识别。该识别结果证实了Athey和Haile（2002）关于具有不可观测异质性的对称升序拍卖模型的一个猜想。扩展允许异质性测量误差，拓宽了其在额外实证环境中的适用性，包括非对称拍卖和工资报价模型。我们调整了现有的模拟样条估计器，并展示了其在有限样本中的表现。

articles.abstract_en: This paper considers the problem of deriving heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation robust (HAR) inference about a scalar parameter of interest. The main assumption is that there is a known upper bound on the degree of persistence in data. I derive finite‐sample optimal tests in the Gaussian location model and show that the robustness‐efficiency tradeoffs embedded in the optimal tests are essentially determined by the maximal persistence. I find that with an appropriate adjustment to the critical value, it is nearly optimal to use the so‐called equal‐weighted cosine (EWC) test, where the long‐run variance is estimated by projections onto q type II cosines. The practical implications are an explicit link between the choice of q and assumptions on the underlying persistence, as well as a corresponding adjustment to the usual Student‐t critical value. I illustrate the results in two empirical examples.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考虑了关于标量参数的异方差和自相关稳健（HAR）推断问题。主要假设是数据持久性程度存在已知上界。我在高斯位置模型中推导了有限样本最优检验，并表明最优检验中嵌入的稳健性-效率权衡本质上由最大持久性决定。我发现，通过对临界值进行适当调整，使用所谓的等权余弦（EWC）检验几乎是最优的，其中长期方差通过投影到q个II型余弦上来估计。实际意义在于，q的选择与对潜在持久性的假设之间存在明确联系，以及对通常的Student-t临界值进行相应调整。我在两个实证例子中说明了这些结果。

articles.title_en: Purchasing seats in school choice and inequality
articles.title_cn: 择校中的购买座位与不平等
articles.abstract_en: We study a mechanism that gives students the option of paying higher tuition to attend their preferred schools. This seat‐purchasing mechanism is neither strategyproof nor stable. Our paper combines administrative and survey data to estimate students' preferences and conducts welfare analysis. We find that changing from a deferred acceptance mechanism to the cadet‐optimal stable mechanism reduces students' welfare but that adopting the observed seat‐purchasing mechanism alleviates this welfare loss. Moreover, students from affluent communities prefer to pay higher tuition to stay at preferred schools, while those from less affluent communities are more likely be priced out to lower‐quality schools.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一种机制，该机制给予学生支付更高学费以就读其偏好学校的选择权。这种购买座位的机制既非策略证明也非稳定。我们的论文结合行政和调查数据来估计学生的偏好，并进行福利分析。我们发现，从延迟接受机制转变为学员最优稳定机制会降低学生的福利，但采用观察到的购买座位机制可以缓解这种福利损失。此外，来自富裕社区的学生更倾向于支付更高学费以留在偏好学校，而来自较不富裕社区的学生则更可能因价格过高而被排挤到质量较低的学校。

articles.title_en: Capital income jumps and wealth distribution
articles.title_cn: 资本收入跳跃和财富分配
articles.abstract_en: Compared to the distributions of earnings, the distributions of wealth in the US and many other countries are strikingly concentrated on the top and skewed to the right. To explain the income and wealth inequality, we provide a tractable heterogeneous‐agent model with incomplete markets in continuous time. We separate illiquid capital assets from liquid bond assets and introduce jump risks to capital income, which are crucial for generating a thicker tail of the wealth distribution than that of the labor income distribution. Under recursive utility, we derive optimal consumption and wealth in closed form and show that the stationary wealth distribution has an exponential right tail that closely approximates a power‐law distribution. Our calibrated model can match the income and wealth distributions in the US data including the extreme right tail of the wealth distribution.
articles.abstract_cn: 与收入分配相比，美国和许多其他国家的财富分配明显集中在上层并向右倾斜。为了解释收入和财富不平等，我们提供了一个在连续时间内具有不完全市场的易处理的异质代理模型。我们将非流动性资本资产与流动性债券资产分开，并引入资本收入跳跃风险，这对于产生比劳动收入分配更厚的财富分配尾部至关重要。在递归效用下，我们以封闭形式导出最优消费和财富，并表明平稳财富分布具有指数右尾，非常接近幂律分布。我们的校准模型可以匹配美国数据中的收入和财富分布，包括财富分布的极右尾部。

articles.title_en: Differences in euro‐area household finances and their relevance for monetary‐policy transmission
articles.title_cn: 欧元区家庭财务状况差异及其对货币政策传导的相关性
articles.abstract_en: This paper quantifies mechanisms through which heterogeneity in household finances affects the transmission of monetary policy, considering housing tenure choices over the life cycle. Our analysis also identifies challenges for monetary policy related to housing busts. It focuses on the four largest economies in the euro area: France, Germany, Italy, and Spain. Through the lens of our model, we find that home ownership and endogenous transitions from renting to owning are key elements for the extent of cross‐country asymmetries in aggregate consumption responses to changes in the real interest rate. Across groups with different housing tenure, we find that the consumption response of homeowners to interest rate changes tends to be larger than the response of renters, particularly if these homeowners are indebted and do not adjust their illiquid housing wealth.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文量化了家庭财务异质性影响货币政策传导的机制，考虑了生命周期中的住房所有权选择。我们的分析还指出了与住房市场崩溃相关的货币政策挑战。研究聚焦于欧元区四大经济体：法国、德国、意大利和西班牙。通过我们的模型视角，我们发现，住房所有权以及从租房到购房的内生转换，是实际利率变化对总消费反应中跨国不对称程度的关键因素。在不同住房所有权群体中，我们发现，房主对利率变化的消费反应往往大于租房者，特别是当这些房主负有债务且不调整其非流动性住房财富时。
